title: Bonafide Certificate
answer: To get a Bonafide Certificate or Demand Letter, first log in to the JIS Portal and submit a request online. After applying, visit Room 408 for physical verification and collection.

title: ID Card Lost
answer: If you lost your ID card, report immediately to the Student Section and apply for a duplicate ID card through the university portal.

title: Transcript
answer: Applications for Transcripts, Migration, and NOC must be submitted directly through the Examination Cell or JIS Student Portal.
